description: Register this agent on the bus (or rejoin under the same name) with a role and capabilities so other agents can find and task it. Do this before sending, claiming, or writing. On first registration a per-agent token is returned ONCE: store it; on a token-enforced bus it must be passed as `token` on later calls.

agent.description: Your unique agent name on this bus. Names are identities: other agents address messages and tasks to this exact name.

capabilities.description: Skills or services you offer, as short strings. Other agents use these to pick who should take a task.

role.description: What you do, in a few words (for example "planner", "builder", "reviewer"). Shown in agent lists.

token.description: Your current per-agent token, required on token-enforced buses when rejoining.

name: bus_register
